graph_family.name: square of a path
graph_family.vertices: 1,...,n, where n=8m and m is a positive integer

quantifiers: For every m >= 1 and every real X in R^(8m x 3) with all row Euclidean norms <=1, the operator inverse constant over every supported symmetric D satisfies the stated lower bound.
main_lower_bound: inf_X sup_{D != 0} ||D||_2 / ||DX||_F >= max(1, n^(1/4)/sqrt(24 sqrt(5))) -> infinity
additional_lower_bound: If r=min_i ||x_i||>0, K_2(X)>=max(1/r, r sqrt(n)/(24 sqrt(5))). Thus unit-row designs have K_2(X)>=sqrt(n)/(24 sqrt(5)).
assumptions: off-diagonal support is contained in the stated known graph
exactly three real query columns, with arbitrary dense entries allowed
each query row has Euclidean norm at most one
absolute action error measured in Frobenius norm
recovery error measured in operator norm
degenerate_cases: A zero row or a noninjective action map gives infinite inverse constant and is handled separately.
proof_mechanism: Four orthogonal localized skew-rotation fields, adjoint nullity three, a nonzero singular-value bound, then the sqrt(n) Frobenius-to-operator inequality and the diagonal 1/r lower bound.
not_claimed: impossibility of four or five queries
a lower bound derived solely from star coloring
verification_status: Self-contained proof plus supplementary exact rational and small numerical checks; not yet independently peer-reviewed.
